tasks.title: Задача 1
tasks.statement:
The apparent diameter of the Moon, as seen from the Earth, is 31'. What is the image diameter in the
objective focal plane if its focal length is 254 cm and the objective diameter is 40 cm? Draw a figure (a few
figures) to explain your calculations.

parts.question: Приведите полное решение (с доказательством или выводом).

tasks.title: Задача 2
tasks.statement:
A photometer is mounted on a 125 cm (focal length) telescope. Can you observe a star with magnitude

          m
   a. 5
           m
   b. 10
           m
   c. 15

                                                                                                     m
in a cluster if a count from a star of a similar spectral type with magnitude 8 gives 4000 counts/second?
The level of white noise of the photometer (instrumental noise) is 500 counts/second; the upper limiting
value for observations is 200000 counts/second. Explain your calculations.

Group B (seniors, > 16 years old).

parts.question: Приведите полное решение (с доказательством или выводом).

tasks.title: Задача 3
tasks.statement:
Where (on the Earth) and when is it possible to observe the sunrise with the longest duration? Estimate
its duration.

parts.question: Приведите полное решение (с доказательством или выводом).

tasks.title: Задача 4
tasks.statement:
Usually we consider that there are about 6000 stars in the whole sky which are visible by our eyes.
Estimate, how many visible stars are circumpolar (which means that they never set):

   a. if you are placed 1 from the North Pole.
   b. if you are placed 1 from the Equator (to the North).

Note: formula for sphere's area calculation: S = 4R2.

parts.question: Приведите полное решение (с доказательством или выводом).

tasks.title: Задача 5
tasks.statement:
An airship started from a cosmodrome located near the equator of the earth at the moment of a sunset.
A pilot of the airship wants to continue to observe the sun on the horizon. What should the speed of
moving of the airship be? Describe in detail the motion of the air ship.

parts.question: Приведите полное решение (с доказательством или выводом).

tasks.title: Задача 6
tasks.statement:
Suppose that a total solar eclipse is observed from a place at the equator when the sun is in zenith. Also,
suppose that the shadow of the moon moves along the equator. Calculate the speed of the shadow relative
to the observer.

parts.question: Приведите полное решение (с доказательством или выводом).
